answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 148886 Country: India Title: How to get rid of masturbation? Question: I use to masturbate quite often, I heard that it is haram and any person who performs haram activity, no ibadah, performed by him, is accepted by Allah for about 40 days. I wanted to know the ibadah which I performed after that haram activities will it get accepted by Allah? Answer ID: 148886 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 672/638/M=5/1438) Masturbation is unlawful and heinous act. No doubt a haram work is sinister. Unlawful activity removes the brightness, spirituality and prosperity. But the reason that salah of forty days is not accepted due to it is related to wine. It is in hadith: “Whoever drinks wine, salah is not accepted from him for forty days.” من شرب الخمر لم يقبلالله له صلاة أربعين صباحاً. However, you should avoid masturbation and each and every unlawful practice. In-shaAllah, your prayer shall be accepted. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
